notes: bed_bath_table (R$497,971), watches_gifts (R$486,519), and health_beauty (R$481,143) are within a narrow band at the top.
sports_leisure follows at R$447,547 and computers_accessories at R$400,491.
The top five categories span roughly R$400k to R$498k in revenue.

assumptions: Revenue is the sum of item price over sales (is_sale = true), excluding freight.
Categories are ranked by total revenue across all of 2017; the analysis window restriction does not apply to a full-year total.
definitions: Category: English name; unknown if missing
Sale: status is not canceled or unavailable
Revenue: item prices of sales, excluding freight

caveats: Revenue excludes freight and counts only sales (status not canceled or unavailable).
Categories with missing names are labeled unknown and may not appear here.

evidence.sql: SELECT category, ROUND(SUM(price), 2) AS revenue FROM analytics.order_items WHERE is_sale = TRUE AND purchase_date >= CAST('2017-01-01' AS DATE) AND purchase_date < CAST('2018-01-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY category ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 5
